articles.title: NASA's X-59 Pulls Off Dizzying Stunts — and It's Designed to Replace Sonic Booms With a Gentle 'Thump'
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin's X-59 just completed its most aggressive maneuvers yet, hitting Mach 0.95. The experimental NASA jet is engineered to turn the window-rattling sonic boom into a soft thump, potentially reviving supersonic travel over land.

articles.title: Flipping Magnetic Fields Creates Exotic Quantum Matter That Defies Expectations
articles.summary: Cal Poly researchers found that periodically switching a magnetic field can generate entirely new quantum states with no static counterpart. The discovery could make quantum computers more stable and resistant to errors.

articles.title: Ancient Life Cracked a Scarcity Problem: It Used a Metal That Was Almost Impossible to Find
articles.summary: A NASA-funded study reveals that life on Earth began using molybdenum over 3.7 billion years ago, despite its extreme scarcity. The finding reshapes how we search for life on other worlds.
